name: Wang Haibin

notes: Identity and role unverified: BioRay's own pages (news included) do not mention him. Do not confuse with BIORAY, the US herbal-supplement brand (bioray.com). Needs a manual check (e.g. BioRay's HKEX filing or the Hisun Pharma annual report) before outreach.

name: Tim Glaser
profile: Engineer who co-founded PostHog with James Hawkins on 23 January 2020 in Y Combinator's W20 batch. PostHog grew from open-source product analytics into a full product/data platform (session replay, feature flags, experiments, data warehouse, AI) with 100,000+ customers. It has been cash-flow positive since Dec 2024 and raised a $70M Stripe-led Series D and a $75M Series E in 2025; valued $1B+.
interesting_fact: PostHog launched its MVP on Hacker News just four weeks after the founders started writing code. Later it moved from PostgreSQL to ClickHouse to support billions of events.
deep_cut_fact: PostHog was not Glaser and Hawkins's first idea. Their first startup together (Aug 2019) aimed to help engineers manage technical debt; it didn't work, but it convinced them to treat 'growth as an engineering problem.'
notes: More engineering-focused and lower profile than co-CEO James Hawkins, who handles most public comms. No personal social handle was confirmed on PostHog pages (profiles are client-rendered); use press@posthog.com or go via Hawkins.
